purpose: The things that go wrong, or get awkward, on a waitlist site that neither the visitor nor the owner will think to specify. One check per edge is expected in e2e/.

status.handled: Defined behaviour, clear to the visitor and the owner.
status.partial: Copes, but someone may be left unaware.
status.open: Needs an owner decision or a feature this version excludes.

tested.yes: An automated check in e2e/ proves it.

edges.edge: Visitor submits with the email empty or malformed.
edges.visitor_sees: A message under the email field ('Please enter a valid email address'); what they typed stays.
edges.owner_sees: Nothing stored.
edges.default_behavior: Validate on the server with Zod. Also validate in the browser for speed.

edges.edge: The same email joins twice.
edges.visitor_sees: The same thank-you as the first time.
edges.owner_sees: One signup, not two.
edges.default_behavior: Email is unique (lower-cased, trimmed). A repeat changes nothing and reveals nothing.

edges.edge: A required question is left blank.
edges.owner_sees: Nothing stored.
edges.default_behavior: Required flags come from the form fields.

edges.edge: A select value is submitted that is not one of the options (a tampered form).
edges.visitor_sees: A generic 'please check your answers' message.
edges.owner_sees: Nothing stored.
edges.default_behavior: Validate every answer against the field's current options on the server.

edges.edge: A very long value, or HTML and script text, is entered in a text field.
edges.visitor_sees: A message that the value is too long, or the text is accepted as plain text.
edges.owner_sees: The text shown as plain text, never run.
edges.default_behavior: Maximum lengths on every field; output is escaped everywhere, including the CSV and the owner list.

edges.edge: The visitor double-clicks Submit.
edges.owner_sees: One signup.
edges.default_behavior: Disable the button while sending; the unique email also protects the data.

edges.edge: A bot fills the hidden honeypot field. A real visitor never does, so a browser autofilling it (a field named website, url or email) must not be possible.
edges.owner_sees: Nothing stored.
edges.default_behavior: Accept silently so the bot learns nothing.

edges.edge: Many submissions come from one address in a short time.
edges.visitor_sees: The first five in ten minutes are accepted; the sixth sees a friendly 'please try again in a few minutes' message.
edges.owner_sees: Only the allowed ones stored.
edges.default_behavior: In-database or in-memory rate limit keyed on the first forwarded address.

edges.edge: The server or database is unreachable when the visitor submits.
edges.visitor_sees: A general message ('Something went wrong, please try again') with what they typed kept.
edges.owner_sees: A line in a 'Recent problems' list on the Signups page.
edges.default_behavior: Never show a stack trace. Record the failure.

edges.edge: Names or answers contain accents, emoji or right-to-left text.
edges.owner_sees: The same, in the list and in the CSV.
edges.default_behavior: UTF-8 everywhere; the CSV starts with a byte-order mark so spreadsheets read it correctly.

edges.edge: A signup's name or answer starts with =, +, - or @ (a spreadsheet formula).
edges.owner_sees: The text shown literally in the spreadsheet.
edges.default_behavior: Prefix such cells (also those starting with a tab or carriage return) with an apostrophe in the CSV.

edges.edge: The owner downloads a CSV with thousands of rows.
edges.owner_sees: The whole file downloads without a timeout.
edges.default_behavior: Stream the rows rather than loading all of them into memory.

edges.edge: The ?src= value is empty, very long or contains odd characters.
edges.owner_sees: A clean, short source label, or 'direct'.
edges.default_behavior: Trim, lower-case, keep letters, numbers, dash and underscore, cut at 60 characters.

edges.edge: A navigation link has no target (for example Contact with no contact email).
edges.owner_sees: A hint in settings: 'Add a contact email to show a Contact link'.
edges.default_behavior: Only render links that have a real target.

edges.edge: A block is hidden but a navigation link points to it.
edges.owner_sees: The link disappears with the block.
edges.default_behavior: Navigation is derived from the visible blocks.

edges.edge: The hero or preview image is missing, huge, or fails to load.
edges.visitor_sees: A calm placeholder and readable text; the page does not jump.
edges.owner_sees: A message at upload time if the file is too large or the wrong type.
edges.default_behavior: Accept JPEG, PNG, WebP up to 8 MB; store width and height; show a placeholder on failure.

edges.edge: The owner uploads an image without a description.
edges.owner_sees: A message asking for a short description.
edges.default_behavior: Alt text is required for every shown image.

edges.edge: Text over the hero image is hard to read on bright images.
edges.owner_sees: A dimming setting (none, soft, strong) on the Hero panel.
edges.default_behavior: Default is soft dimming unless the brief sets a dimming value, which wins; contrast of at least 4.5:1 is checked.

edges.edge: The owner saves empty text for a required block field (for example the headline).
edges.owner_sees: A message next to the field.
edges.default_behavior: Zod schemas require headline, button label and form email field.

edges.edge: The owner removes the form's option that earlier signups chose.
edges.owner_sees: The old answers still show as text in the list and breakdown.
edges.default_behavior: Answers are stored as text; the breakdown counts removed options under their old label, marked 'removed'.

edges.edge: The owner hides every block except the footer.
edges.visitor_sees: A page with only a footer.
edges.owner_sees: A warning that the waitlist block is hidden and no one can join.
edges.default_behavior: Warn on save when the waitlist block is hidden.

edges.edge: Someone guesses the admin password.
edges.owner_sees: A lockout message after five failed attempts in ten minutes.
edges.default_behavior: Rate limit sign-in by address; generic error message.

edges.edge: An admin page or API is requested without a session.
edges.owner_sees: Not applicable.
edges.default_behavior: Every /admin route and owner API checks the session on the server.

edges.edge: The owner deletes a signup by mistake.
edges.owner_sees: A confirmation first; after confirming the signup is gone.
edges.default_behavior: Permanent delete after a confirmation. There is no undo in this version.

edges.edge: The goal period has ended or the goal is already reached.
edges.owner_sees: 'Goal reached: 120 of 100' or 'Goal period ended: 61 of 100', not a negative number of days.
edges.default_behavior: Cap the days left at zero and state the outcome in words.

edges.edge: No one has signed up yet.
edges.owner_sees: An empty-state message with the site's address and a hint about ?src=.
edges.default_behavior: Never show an empty table or division by zero.

edges.edge: Sample signups are left in the database.
edges.owner_sees: Sample rows labelled 'Sample' and a 'Delete all samples' button; samples are shown in the list, labelled, and left out of every count and of the goal progress.
edges.default_behavior: Samples never count toward the goal.

edges.edge: A crawler asks for robots.txt, the sitemap or an admin page.
edges.owner_sees: Not applicable.
edges.default_behavior: robots.txt and the sitemap exist; admin pages are noindex and disallowed.

edges.edge: The brief gives no claim for a feature that sounds like one (security, certifications, user counts).
edges.owner_sees: A line in AGENT_LOG.md listing every sentence that makes a claim and where it came from.
edges.default_behavior: Never invent claims, testimonials, logos or numbers. Leave them out.

edges.edge: A visitor asks to be removed from the list.
edges.visitor_sees: The privacy note says how to ask (the contact email, if there is one).
edges.owner_sees: Can delete the signup from the list.
edges.default_behavior: If there is no contact email, the privacy note says only what is stored and why.

edges.edge: The site starts without a database address or owner credentials.
edges.owner_sees: A clear startup message naming the missing setting.
edges.default_behavior: Validate environment variables when the server starts (an instrumentation hook; the build itself cannot check them) and refuse to start with a readable error.

edges.edge: Image storage is not configured in a deployed site.
edges.owner_sees: A message on the upload field that images cannot be uploaded yet and why.
edges.default_behavior: A storage adapter: local disk in development, Vercel Blob when deployed; a deployed site without a store token shows the message.
